question: ‘A Passage to India’, a novel about the British Empire, was written by which of the following authors?
solution:
The correct answer is __**EM Forster**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• EM Forster was a renowned English novelist, short story writer, and essayist.
 
• "A Passage to India" was published in 1924 and is one of Forster's most famous works.
 
• The novel explores the racial tensions and prejudices during the British rule in India.
 
• Forster's other notable works include "Howards End" and "A Room with a View".
